sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach remain top with 22 points from 10 games despite that defeat, and face a struggling Alsager side who sit bottom of the table with just 4 points from 10 matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a mid-table clash on Saturday. AFC Bridgnorth, currently third, host Eccleshall at home—a meeting between two in-form sides, with Eccleshall having won their last match and Bridgnorth bouncing back from recent losses. Wolverhampton Casuals (4th, on a three-game winning streak) visit Wednesfield Community (10th) on Saturday before facing Brereton Social away on Wednesday evening in a midweek fixture. Bilston Town welcome Foley Meir, Barnton host Shawbury United (winless in their last six), and there are clashes involving Brereton Social v Widnes Town, Cheadle Heath Nomads v Telford Town, Crewe v Allscott Heath, and Market Drayton Town v New Mills—all on Saturday at 15:00.
